_comment: Exact-record Bitwarden Secrets Manager bindings for bin/resend-cli. Each record is {id: <secret UUID>, key: <record name>}; the wrapper checks id, key and project before accepting the value. Replace these placeholder UUIDs in your private overlay. Optional: an "accounts" object of account name -> record name (for example {"main": "RESEND_API_KEY_MAIN", "second": "RESEND_API_KEY_SECOND"}) plus "default_account" enables the wrapper's --account flag; without it the only account is "main".
